title: 我现在累得下了班就想睡觉
en: I'm so tired that I want to sleep right after work

ex.hz: 北京是一个很大的城市。
ex.py: Běijīng shì yí ge hěn dà de chéngshì.
ex.en: Beijing is a very big city.

ex.hz: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
ex.py: Rúguǒ míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
ex.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

ex.py: Wǒ rènwéi zhège bànfǎ hěn hǎo.
ex.en: I think this way is very good.

ex.hz: 爸爸有两双黑色的皮鞋。
ex.py: Bàba yǒu liǎng shuāng hēisè de píxié.
ex.en: Dad has two pairs of black leather shoes.

ex.py: Wàimian hěn lěng, dàishang màozi ba.
ex.en: It's cold outside; put on a hat.

ex.py: Zhège xiǎohái zhǎng de zhēn kuài.
ex.en: This child is growing so fast.

ex.py: Tā de xiǎo gǒu kě'ài jí le.
Zhè tiáo hé yǒu sān mǐ kuān.
ex.en: This river is three metres wide.

ex.py: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng gōngjīn píngguǒ.
ex.en: I bought two kilograms of apples.

ex.py: Tā de bízi yòu gāo yòu dà.
ex.en: His nose is tall and big.

ex.py: Wǒ mèimei de tóufa hěn cháng.
ex.en: My younger sister's hair is very long.

ex.hz: 我每天早上和晚上都刷牙。
ex.py: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang hé wǎnshang dōu shuā yá.
ex.en: I brush my teeth every morning and evening.

ex.hz: 我和同学的关系都很好。
ex.py: Wǒ hé tóngxué de guānxì dōu hěn hǎo.
ex.en: I get on well with all my classmates.

ex.hz: 别人的东西不能随便拿。
ex.py: Biérén de dōngxi bù néng suíbiàn ná.
ex.en: You shouldn't take other people's things freely.

ex.py: Zhège cíyǔ wǒ bú tài dǒng.
ex.en: I don't quite understand this word.

lines.hz: 你看，我新买的帽子怎么样？
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, wǒ xīn mǎi de màozi zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: Look, what do you think of the hat I just bought?

lines.py: Hónghóng de, zhēn kě'ài! Duōshao qián?
lines.en: Nice and red, so cute! How much was it?

lines.hz: 不贵，八十块。如果你喜欢，我也给你买一个。
lines.py: Bú guì, bāshí kuài. Rúguǒ nǐ xǐhuan, wǒ yě gěi nǐ mǎi yí ge.
lines.en: Not expensive, eighty yuan. If you like it, I'll buy you one too.

lines.hz: 好啊，不过我认为黑色的更好。
lines.py: Hǎo a, búguò wǒ rènwéi hēisè de gèng hǎo.
lines.en: Great, but I think a black one would be better.

questions.q: What colour is A's new hat?
What will A do if B likes it?
options: Take it back to the shop

lines.py: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlai hěn lèi.

lines.hz: 这几天工作太忙，我每天累得刷完牙就想睡觉。
lines.py: Zhè jǐ tiān gōngzuò tài máng, wǒ měi tiān lèi de shuāwán yá jiù xiǎng shuìjiào.
lines.en: Work has been so busy these days; every night I'm so tired I want to sleep the moment I've brushed my teeth.

lines.hz: 我认为你应该多休息，别人的工作不要都做。
lines.py: Wǒ rènwéi nǐ yīnggāi duō xiūxi, biérén de gōngzuò bú yào dōu zuò.
lines.en: I think you should rest more and not do everyone else's work too.

lines.hz: 你说得对。如果明天不忙，我就早点儿回家。
lines.py: Nǐ shuō de duì. Rúguǒ míngtiān bù máng, wǒ jiù zǎodiǎnr huí jiā.
lines.en: You're right. If I'm not busy tomorrow, I'll go home early.

questions.q: What will B do if he is not busy tomorrow?

grammar.en: 如果 A，就 B: if A, then B (the subject goes before 就)

drills.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go to the park.
If you're tired, go and rest.

drills.q: 如果我有钱的话，我___买一辆新车。
drills.en: If I had money, I'd buy a new car.

drills.q: 如果你喜欢这件衣服，___买吧。
drills.en: If you like these clothes, then buy them.

drills.q: 如果你有问题，我们___一起想办法。
drills.en: If you have a problem, we'll think of a way together.

grammar.en: 得 complement of state: 累得 … / 高兴得 …: so … that …

drills.q: 听到这个消息，她高兴___哭了。
drills.en: She was so happy at the news that she cried.
She was so tired that she went to sleep as soon as she got home.
I'm so tired today that I don't want to cook.
I was so busy that I had no time for lunch.
The children were having so much fun that they didn't even want to go home.

grammar.en: a one-syllable adjective said twice + 的 paints a more vivid picture

drills.en: The child's hands are tiny and lovely.
That river is wide and the water is clean.

drills.q: 这条路长长___，我们走了很久。
drills.en: This road is so long; we walked for ages.

drills.q: 她的眼睛___，笑起来很好看。
drills.en: Her eyes are big and she looks nice when she smiles.

lines: 还是很疼，我明天去医院检查。
你看那只小狗，眼睛大大的，真可爱！

judge.text: 我最近忙得没时间见朋友，所以有点儿累。
如果明天下雨，我们就在家看电影。
judge.claim: 明天下雨的话，他们会在家看电影。

judge.text: 他的鞋太小，所以他把它送给了弟弟。
我每天睡觉以前刷牙，早上也刷牙。

replies.q: 你认为这个办法怎么样？
如果你有钱，你想做什么？
